test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of a trapezium is 1792 cm² and the perpendicular distance between its parallel sides is 28 cm. If the length of one of the parallel sides is 72 cm, then find the length of the other side.
solution:
**Given, **

The area of a trapezium (A) = 1792 cm² 

Perpendicular distance (h) = 28 cm 

Length of one of the parallel sides (a) = 72 cm 

**Formula used:** 

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (a + b) × h, 

Where a and b are the lengths of the parallel sides and **h** stands for the perpendicular distance between the parallel sides.** **

**Calculation:** 

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7faf1d5b1c97bf90458c1cb995363122b456a686da7bedeee113bf65cf5170.png] 

⇒ 1792 = 1/2 × (72 + b) × 28 cm² 

⇒ 1792 = (72 + b) × 14 

⇒ 128 = (72 + b) 

⇒ b = 128 − 72

⇒ b = 56 cm.

**∴ The length of the other parallel side (b) is 56 cm.**
